App_Blurb: Pody Network is a decentralized finance platform on EduChain, redefining student finance by building credit scores based on academic performance, classroom participation, and reputation. Incubated by Open Campus, it offers collateral-free overdrafts and financial inclusion for education, making loans accessible without traditional collateral. Users can earn rewards through active engagement, such as joining classrooms and completing tasks. As part of the Open Campus ecosystem, Pody transforms learning into a pathway for financial empowerment, integrating Web3 incentives like Yuzu Points for on-chain activities. With tamper-proof certificates and analytics, it supports educators and institutions while fostering a global community of learners who can monetize their educational efforts in a secure, transparent manner.
Features: Tamper-proof certificates and student management analytics.
Community engagement through online classroom spaces and real-time chat.
Incubated by Open Campus for EduFi and classroom innovation.
Credit score building based on academic performance and participation.
Collateral-free overdrafts for student loans and financial support.
